description: Race and Hispanic origin as NHANES codes it (RIDRETH3). Kept beside the NIH CDE Race/Ethnicity Self-Identification it is mapped to; the mapping is in the generator and Other Race including multi-racial has no CDE value.

label: Red Cell Distribution Width
description: Red Cell Distribution Width (LBXRDW, LOINC 788-0).

label: Respondent Sequence Number (SEQN)
description: The NHANES respondent sequence number, the identifier every NHANES file carries for a participant (SEQN).

label: Smoked at Least 100 Cigarettes in Life (SMQ020)
description: Whether the participant has smoked at least 100 cigarettes in their life (SMQ020).

label: Difficulty Standing for Long Periods (PFQ061M)
description: Difficulty Standing for Long Periods (PFQ061M), on the four-point difficulty scale.

label: Difficulty Standing Up from an Armless Chair (PFQ061I)
description: Difficulty Standing Up from an Armless Chair (PFQ061I), on the four-point difficulty scale.

label: Still Have Asthma (MCQ035)
description: Whether the participant still has asthma (MCQ035).

label: Difficulty Stooping, Crouching or Kneeling (PFQ061D)
description: Difficulty Stooping, Crouching or Kneeling (PFQ061D), on the four-point difficulty scale.

label: Taken Prescription Medicine, Past Month (RXDUSE)
description: Whether the participant took prescription medicine in the past 30 days (RXDUSE).

label: Difficulty Walking Between Rooms (PFQ061H)
description: Difficulty Walking Between Rooms (PFQ061H), on the four-point difficulty scale.

label: Difficulty Walking a Quarter Mile (PFQ061B)
description: Difficulty Walking a Quarter Mile (PFQ061B), on the four-point difficulty scale.

description: Difficulty Walking Up Ten Stairs (PFQ061C), on the four-point difficulty scale.

label: Procedure Code (ICD-9-CM)
description: An ICD-9-CM volume 3 procedure code as recorded on a Medicare inpatient claim, without the decimal point.

label: Smoking Status
description: Tobacco smoking status (LOINC 72166-2) as the survey establishes it: NHANES from SMQ020 and SMQ040, BRFSS from SMOKE100 and SMOKDAY2 (the agency's _SMOKER3 is kept beside it). The LOINC answer list LL2201-3.

label: Code System: HCPCS
description: The code system of a coded value, fixed: HCPCS Level I (CPT) and Level II (http://www.ama-assn.org/go/cpt and https://www.cms.gov/medicare/coding-billing/healthcare-common-procedure-system). FHIR Coding.system.

label: Code System: ICD-9-CM
description: The code system of a coded value, fixed: ICD-9-CM (http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-9-cm). FHIR Coding.system.

label: Code System: NDC
description: The code system of a coded value, fixed: the National Drug Code (http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/ndc). FHIR Coding.system.

label: Veteran Status
description: Whether the person has ever served on active duty in the United States Armed Forces (NHANES DMQMILIZ; BRFSS VETERAN3).
